name_en: Shoyu no mi — a fermented soybean-and-grain relish eaten in place of soy sauce
summary_ja: 大豆、小麦、米に種麹を混ぜた麹に塩水を加えて発酵させる庄内の万能調味料で、江戸時代から食べられてきたという。ご飯にのせたり冷奴や焼き肉のたれに使ったりと、麹の量で甘みや塩気が家ごとに変わる。
summary_en: Soybean, wheat, and rice are mixed with koji and left to ferment with salted water into an all-purpose Shonai relish said to date to the Edo period. It goes over rice, onto cold tofu, or into a grilling sauce, its sweetness and salt shifting with how much koji each household uses.
source_title: しょうゆの実 山形県 | うちの郷土料理：農林水産省
